newsitem.title: FRANCE: GEC Alsthom wins power plant order in China.
newsitem.headline: GEC Alsthom wins power plant order in China.

text.p: Franco-British joint venture GEC Alsthom said on Monday it won an order worth 26 million Ecu ($30.5 million) to build a power plant in China.

GEC Alsthom said in a statement the contract awarded by the China Petroleum Technology and Development Corporation is for supply of a 110 MW combined cycle power station for the TARIM Petrochemical plant at Kuerle City in the Xiangjiang region.

GEC Alsthom will design and build a VEGA 206 power plant, which will incorporate two Frame Six gas turbine generators, two heat recovery steam generators, one TM2 steam turbine generator, auxiliary equipment and distributed control system.
The plant is scheduled to enter combined cycle operation in October 1998.
GEC Alsthom is jointly owned by Britain's General Electric Co Plc and France's Alcatel Alsthom
